title.zh: 分散投资 · 为什么不把鸡蛋放一个篮子里
title.en: Diversification · Why Not Put All Eggs in One Basket

desc.zh: 组合波动看的是资产之间的相关性，不是数量；十只同涨同跌的资产约等于一只。
desc.en: A portfolio's wobble depends on how its assets move together, not how many there are; ten assets moving as one behave like one.
